name: MilestoneBillingScheduler
tagline: Fixed-fee milestone billing with acceptance gates, an invoice-ready queue and revenue vs billing timing.
description: A complete professional-services billing module for Power Apps and Power Pages: plan fixed-fee milestone schedules, gate invoices on client acceptance, generate invoice batches and see unbilled and deferred revenue per contract.
features: Acceptance-gated invoicing with SLA and deemed acceptance
Invoice batch generation with numbering, retention and tax
Revenue recognition by % complete, acceptance or invoice
Unbilled (contract asset) and deferred (contract liability) revenue
Timeline with keyboard reschedule and undo
Client acceptance mode for Power Pages portals
Demo mode, Power Fx outputs and events
controlType: standard (2 controls: MilestoneBillingScheduler data-set + MilestoneBillingSchedulerPortal field control)
